response.original_title: [~Info™ Passenger] How Do I Add an Passenger on Silversea?
response.overview: To add a passenger to your Silversea Cruise, call Silversea Cruises customer service at ☎ +1-866-259-1002(US/Canada) or +1 (866) 259-1002 [UK]. Share your booking confirmation number and the new passenger’s details. The representative can check whether your cabin ☎ +1-866-259-1002(US/Canada) accommodates another guest and explain any extra charges. Passenger additions depend on cabin capacity, availability, and applicable booking rules. To add a passenger to an existing Silversea Cruise reservation 1-866-259-1002, you must call Silversea Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1-866-259-1002, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a passenger to an Silversea Cruise online 1-866-259-1002, so you must contact Silversea customer service or your travel agent directly by phone 1-866-259-1002.
